title: Permission denied
story: You copied prep.sh from a shared folder. It copies your inputs into a prepared folder, but when you run it, Linux refuses. Fix that and run it.

files.~/{{project}}/prep.sh:
#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p prepared
cp inputs/*.pdb prepared/
echo "Prepared files:"
ls prepared

tasks.text: Run prep.sh so the prepared folder gets made

hints: Try `./prep.sh` and read the error. A script needs execute permission before `./` can run it.
`chmod +x prep.sh` gives it permission. Then `./prep.sh` works.
Run `chmod +x prep.sh`, then `./prep.sh`, then `ls prepared` to check.
